configuration: Inline-6, single twin-scroll turbo (integrated exhaust manifold on some variants)
popular_for: Modern high-power platform, excellent tuning potential, used in Supra A90 etc.

exhaust.notes: Some B58 variants (esp. later / Supra) have the exhaust manifold cast into the head with fewer external outlets feeding the turbo directly. Earlier versions have more traditional external ports/manifolds.
exhaust.stud_or_bolt_count: Varies; flanges use multiple fasteners, often with specific chamfer/wedge design
exhaust.flange_style: Custom laser-cut flanges available; port sizing depends on whether stubs are used
useful_checks: Confirm if head has integrated manifold (fewer external ports) or traditional 6-port
Match bolt pattern and chamfers to known B58 flanges
Port diameter consistent with aftermarket primary tubing

sources_notes: Aftermarket B58 head flanges exist (Walton, Lamberts, etc.). Integrated vs non-integrated is a key differentiator for autodetection.
